dialog.interaction_timing_note: All source-enforced 45 s assertions pass. Four notice/credit methods provide explicit interaction intervals; the three colour receipts provide fixture elapsed time, not a separately serialized interaction interval. No fabricated interval is inferred.
observations: Normal advanced colour has a finite scrollable body and fixed visible controls; the palette moves while footer controls remain fixed.

Actual fullscreen Google Latin IME is visible with #13579B selected. Native single Back first hides IME and preserves the original dialog/value/selection without callbacks. Later single Back closes the reopened dialog. No simultaneous IME/body/footer visibility claim.
Native colour-surface drag changes the colour without body scroll; callback receipt remains one commit, three closes and final #2468AC.
Hungarian portrait and landscape captions are visibly complete at the tested scale. This is fit and state evidence, not linguistic fluency.

Notice text is intentionally scrollable; landscape top/bottom clipping at individual scroll positions is consistent with native line reachability receipts. Footer captions remain clear. Retained credit keeps state and native listener flow.

Compared with prior final-run colour captures, early current colour captures have no lingering synthetic save toast. IME suggestion content and status-bar clock are incidental runtime differences. The retained-credit portrait still contains its fixture-generated save toast.
Undimmed editor status-bar text remains low contrast in some API35 captures; this incidental observation is not attributed as a new regression.

fresh_visual_differences: All 96 current screenshots actually inspected. Native vertical format menus, filename, description, Cancel and Choose location are reachable in their respective captured scroll states. Text clipped at a viewport edge is not represented as simultaneous full-content visibility.
Minimum/maximum slider captures agree with native touchscreen traces, preserved scroll offsets and locale-specific direction.

Fresh captures vary from prior full-run frames in clock digits, native input/scroll positions and intermediate display states. They were reviewed as current evidence, not treated as pixel-identical acceptance.
Landscape Arrow can extend beneath its clipped tool viewport. Its visible-center native tap and selected state pass; whole-rectangle reachability applies only to separately asserted Save controls.
Undimmed editor status bar has the same incidental low-contrast observation; dimmed dialog status bars are legible.
